material_changes: Keep ordinary not-present and inattentive adjective senses as the main learner branches.
Keep formal absent oneself from as a live but low-priority verb branch rather than deleting it or presenting it as ordinary speech.
Promote be absent from and absent oneself from into register-aware constructions.

core_clusters.label_en: formally keep oneself away from a place or event

core_concept.core_meaning_cn: 核心是“人不在该在的位置/注意力不在当前对象上”
core_concept.core_meaning_en: not being where one is expected to be, physically or mentally; formally, to keep oneself away
core_concept.mental_model_cn: physical absence → be absent from；mental absence → an absent look；正式主动回避 → absent oneself from。
core_concept.mental_model_en: physical absence, mental absence, then the formal reflexive verb absent oneself from

overrides.definition_cn: 缺席的；不在应在场所的
overrides.definition_en: not present where someone is expected to be
overrides.usage_note: The ordinary frame is be absent from + place/activity.

overrides.definition_en: not paying attention because the mind is elsewhere; preoccupied

overrides.definition_cn: （正式）使自己缺席；避开应在的地方或场合
overrides.definition_en: formal: to keep oneself away from a place or event where one might be expected
overrides.usage_note: Formal and normally reflexive: absent yourself/himself/herself from ...

constructions.meaning_cn: （正式）使自己不参加/离开某处

owners.reason: Current object already preserves the high-value complete/unqualified and unlimited-power branches, keeps the rare noun reference-only, and supplies representative absolute truth/power/monarchy collocations; no material learner decision is missing.

material_changes: Preserve all five current modern senses but organize them under one take-in/take-on model rather than five flat translations.
Promote absorb information, be absorbed in, absorb A into B, and absorb cost/loss/shock into first-class constructions.

core_clusters.label_en: take something in physically or mentally
take something into a larger whole or take on its cost/impact

core_concept.core_meaning_cn: 把外来的东西“吸进来/接进来/承担下来”，可作用于物质、信息、注意力、组织或成本冲击
core_concept.core_meaning_en: to take something in, into, or on: substance, information, attention, an entity, or a cost/impact
core_concept.mental_model_cn: 统一成 take in / take on：水被材料吸收、信息被大脑吸收、注意力被事情占满、公司被并入、成本被承担。
core_concept.mental_model_en: one take-in/take-on model across matter, information, attention, incorporation, and cost or impact

overrides.definition_en: to take in a liquid, gas, energy, or other substance
overrides.sense_label_en: take in a substance or energy

overrides.definition_cn: 理解并记住信息、知识或思想
overrides.definition_en: to understand information or ideas completely and retain them

overrides.definition_cn: 完全吸引注意力；使全神贯注
overrides.definition_en: to take up someone's attention completely; engross
overrides.usage_note: A very common learner frame is be absorbed in + noun/doing.

overrides.definition_cn: 吸收、并入较大的整体或组织
overrides.definition_en: to take a person, group, or company into a larger whole; incorporate

overrides.definition_cn: 承担或消化成本、损失、冲击等
overrides.definition_en: to take on or bear a cost, loss, impact, or shock
overrides.sense_label_en: bear a cost, loss, impact, or shock

constructions.meaning_cn: 承担/消化成本、损失或冲击
